review.evidence: The named controls create native issuer liabilities without an independently enforced collateral cap. The July snapshot reconciles reserve assets against historical ZARU circulation, but a recurring current reserve reconciliation is not established; mint reconciliation stays unknown.
unresolvedQuestions: Report snapshot is July 31, signed August 28; no current financial reconciliation/current weights should be asserted.
ISRS 4400 AUP has no assurance opinion; legal insolvency priority and MMF look-through/duration remain qualified/unproved.
Public independent signer threshold/timelock not demonstrated; EVM powers are a current EOA and Solana authority a system account.
Partner minimum/fees/capacity unquantified; CEX volume is not DEX depth.
Only about seven days of requested 90-day price history; no FX-normalized depeg assertion.
CG circulation matches Solana exactly but excludes observed Arc 100 units (~USD 6); preserve CG provenance, no max-splice/aggregate shortcut.
FSP55172 remains issuer-claimed, not independently pinned regulator authorization.
